data.description:
## What
Write failing tests that assert dso:red-team-reviewer in inference-challenge mode always emits either INFERENCE_CHALLENGE or INFERENCE_SKIP — never silence, never an unrecognized envelope type.

## Test file
tests/scripts/test-red-team-inference-challenge.sh

## Test cases (structural boundary per Behavioral Testing Standard Rule 5)
- Section heading '## Inference-Challenge Mode' exists in plugins/dso/agents/red-team-reviewer.md
- Section heading '## Output: INFERENCE_CHALLENGE' exists in the agent file
- Section heading '## Output: INFERENCE_SKIP' exists in the agent file
- Section '## Sampling Tiers' exists (documents the 100%/20% tiers)
- The agent file references both 'INFERENCE_CHALLENGE' and 'INFERENCE_SKIP' envelope keywords in close proximity to a 'never silence' constraint statement
- The INFERENCE_SKIP section references 'reason' field with values 'sampling' and 'not_in_scope'
- The INFERENCE_SKIP section references 'hash_bucket' field

## Gate
RED — tests must FAIL before any implementation changes are made to red-team-reviewer.md
data.title: RED: test inference-challenge mode in red-team-reviewer emits typed envelope (never silence)
